findings.interpretation: Cloudflare WAF rejects Python-urllib's default User-Agent before the API application handles the request.
The request reaches the LabForge API application when an OpenAI-style User-Agent is used.
The default credential is valid for the LabForge model-list endpoint.
The gpt-5.5 model is available through Chat Completions.
The gpt-5.5 model is available through the Responses API.

root_cause: The prior 403 failures were caused by Cloudflare WAF rule 1010 matching the default Python-urllib User-Agent, not by an invalid API key, an unavailable gpt-5.5 model, an unsupported endpoint, or a proxy setting.
remediation: Use the official OpenAI SDK or explicitly supply an OpenAI-compatible User-Agent for this LabForge gateway. Do not use bare urllib.request without setting User-Agent.
